spec.assertion: buffApply stat maxAmmoPct value 25.66, targetSlug == self, maxStacks 5, observed stacks reach 5 and never exceed. Zeroing the value changes the unit total (proves it is not inert — weapon-state IS damage, taxonomy #6); raising maxStacks 5→50 diverges (proves the cap binds). Fails under the nearest-wrong 'defensive/utility, skip' model and under an uncapped-stacks model.

hitCount:30 — counts landed ROUNDS, not trigger pulls. Rider proc count is asserted ≥ ammo-buff apply count since both kit blocks carry the identical activation clause. Fails if either block were keyed to interval or to a different threshold.

Zeroing atkPct lowers the unit total while leaving shot count identical (proves it is a rider, not a weapon change) and leaving every teammate byte-identical (proves enemy-facing/caster-scaled, not an ally grant). Combined with the skill2a check, the loss ratio s1Loss > 2×s2Loss discriminates the 188.68%/30 vs 61.69%/50 pairing from swapped magnitudes or swapped thresholds.

Zeroing it lowers the unit total; its damage contribution must be less than half the skill1 rider's, which only holds if the 50-hit threshold and 61.69% magnitude are both correct. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'fold into the 30-hit trigger' (over-fires ~1.67×) and under swapped magnitudes.

spec.kitLine: when using Burst Skill: Atk dmg ▲21.12%
spec.assertion: THE load-bearing trigger-identity check. buffApply count for attackDamagePct == this unit's OWN burstCast count. The counterfactual re-keys the block to fullBurstEnter; the control comp contains a second Burst-III unit precisely so the two diverge, and the test asserts the wrong model applies at least as often and deals at least as much, with a strict-divergence guard so it cannot pass vacuously. Also asserts attackDamagePct (Damage-Up bucket) is distinct from the burst's atkPct — both stats are present on this unit, so collapsing them would be detectable.

Wall-clock seconds (not rounds, not stacks — the text says 'sec'). Duration non-vacuity is proven on the burst ATK line: some of the unit's damage frames fall inside a 10s post-cast window and some fall outside, so a permanent-buff mis-encode is detectable. No buffRemove is asserted (the engine emits none on natural lapse).

buffApply atkPct value 97.2 on self, exactly once per own burst cast; removing the effect lowers the unit total and leaves teammates identical (self-scoped). Fails under an allies-scoped mis-target and under a per-full-burst (rather than per-own-cast) trigger.

Removing unlimitedAmmo strictly reduces shots fired AND total damage, and strictly increases reload events. Fails under the nearest-wrong 'flavour text, no-op' model. Teammate inertness asserted (self-scoped weapon state).

spec.kitLine: Hit count for Skill 2 ▼20 for 10 sec
spec.assertion: it.skip. No engine primitive scopes a hit-count-threshold change to the 10s window opened by this unit's OWN burst cast. TriggerDef.hitCount.countInFb is the closest, but it keys to the team Full-Burst state, not the burst-cast window — the two diverge in any comp where another Burst III completes the chain, and the FB window length is not the kit's 10s. Encoding it as countInFb:30 is an approximation; asserting it would validate the approximation rather than the kit line, so the discriminating assertion is written out in the skip body instead of run.

fixtures: controlComp('snow-white-innocent-days', true) — the standard liter(B1)/crown(B2)/carry(B3)/helm(B3) control, boss Fire, focus on the carry. Fixed-B3 slot deliberately KEPT (not set to false): this unit is a Burst III whose skill2b is triggered 'when using Burst Skill', so the presence of a SECOND Burst III is what makes burstCast and fullBurstEnter diverge — the fixture's whole discriminating power for the highest-risk line depends on it. Helm's buffs are ally-scoped stat lifts that shift magnitudes uniformly across the base and counterfactual arms, so every assertion is written as a same-fixture A/B (base vs withPatchedOverride) or as an event-identity/count claim, never as an absolute damage number. All runs hoisted at module scope: 1 base + 6 counterfactuals = 7 full 180s sims, well under the ~20 budget.
gaps: burst 'Hit count required for Skill 2 ▼20 time(s) for 10 sec' — it.skip: no primitive scopes a hit-count threshold change to the owner's 10s burst-cast window. hitCount.countInFb is Full-Burst-scoped, so it over-fires in multi-B3 comps and uses the FB window rather than 10s; modeling it that way is an approximation that should be recorded in the override note, not asserted as the kit line.

⚑ Cadence tuple (pulls/sec, reloadFrames 81) is a datamine-unreliable field per the ALWAYS-⚑ list. Every hit-count-derived proc count in this file therefore depends on an unflagged input — all such assertions are written as RELATIVE comparisons (base vs counterfactual, or one rider vs the other) and never pin an absolute proc count. A future footage-measured cadence would let the 30-hit and 50-hit cadences be pinned exactly.

⚑ noFb / range disposition of the two flat-damage riders (188.68% and 61.69%) is not asserted. Per taxonomy #9 the engine defaults riders to FB-eligible by timing and range-exempt; the kit text gives no basis to override either, and 'measured-only' governs noFb — so this is left to the driver's override rather than pinned blind.

⚑ Core eligibility of the riders is not asserted: neither line says 'core strike damage', so the default (no core) is expected, but the packet's rules make this a measured/derived surface rather than a kit-text claim.
